screening: Each completed source line was paired with every question in its named shared probe set. Initial source-file pass statements are superseded by decisions.json. Scores are provisional author assessments, not measured humor or human approval. Build tooling serializes these decisions; it cannot judge semantic fit.
pool_limits: EXPLAIN admits a comic operating principle, not factual explanation. METHOD admits a visibly impossible procedure. CHOICE admits an impossible criterion, never a named or ordinal winner. WHO uses fictional agents. WHEN uses impossible time markers. WHERE uses explicitly fictional places; physical map-only candidates failed source-retrieval probes. Universal deliberately degrades form. No seen set proves whole-pool suitability.
